name: Retrieval
description: Semantic vector search and RAG knowledge retrieval across project artifacts and documents with built-in query embedding.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Search Query / Question
inputs.helpText: Natural language query or question. Automatically vectorized using the selected embedding model.

inputs.name: embeddingModel
inputs.label: Embedding Model
inputs.helpText: Model used to embed the search query automatically. If omitted, uses system default.

inputs.name: artifactType
inputs.label: Artifact Type Filter
inputs.placeholder: Select from existing, enter custom type, or wire variable (e.g. {{trigger.input.type}})
inputs.helpText: Select from database/canonical artifact types or enter a custom type.

inputs.name: logicalId
inputs.label: Target Logical ID
inputs.helpText: Optional: Restrict vector search to chunks from a specific logical artifact.

inputs.name: keywords
inputs.label: Filter Keywords
inputs.helpText: Optional keywords to filter or match against indexed keywords.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: Max Results (Top K)
inputs.helpText: Maximum number of most relevant chunks to return (defaults to 5).

inputs.name: latestOnly
inputs.label: Latest Version Only
inputs.helpText: Default true. When true, searches only the latest active version of each artifact.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.label: Namespace
inputs.helpText: Optional namespace for organizing and scoping artifacts. Leave blank to match all.
